652	
653	  static parseSmsText(rawBody: string, sender: string): Partial<SmsMessage> {
654	    let parsedAmount: number | undefined;
655	    let parsedReferenceId: string | undefined;
656	    let parsedAccountNumber: string | undefined;
657	    let parsedProvider: AccountProvider = 'other';
658	
659	    const lowerSender = sender.toLowerCase();
660	    const lowerBody = rawBody.toLowerCase();
661	
662	    if (lowerSender.includes('vf') || lowerSender.includes('vodafone') || lowerBody.includes('فودافون كاش')) {
663	      parsedProvider = 'vodafone_cash';
664	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('orange') || lowerBody.includes('أورانج كاش') || lowerBody.includes('اورنج')) {
665	      parsedProvider = 'orange_cash';
666	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('etisalat') || lowerBody.includes('اتصالات كاش')) {
667	      parsedProvider = 'etisalat_cash';
668	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('instapay') || lowerBody.includes('instapay') || lowerBody.includes('انستاباي')) {
669	      parsedProvider = 'instapay';
670	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('rajhi') || lowerBody.includes('الراجحي')) {
671	      parsedProvider = 'al_rajhi';
672	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('ahli') || lowerSender.includes('snb') || lowerBody.includes('الأهلي')) {
673	      parsedProvider = 'al_ahli';
674	    }
675	
676	    const amountRegex = /(?:مبلغ|استلام|تحويل|بمبلغ|قيمة|amount|received)\s*[:]?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)/i;
677	    const matchAmount = rawBody.match(amountRegex);
678	    if (matchAmount && matchAmount[1]) {
679	      parsedAmount = parseFloat(matchAmount[1]);
680	    } else {
681	      const anyNum = rawBody.match(/([0-9]{2,6}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)/);
682	      if (anyNum) parsedAmount = parseFloat(anyNum[1]);
683	    }
684	
685	    const refRegex = /(?:رقم العملية|مرجع|المرجع|العملية|ref|reference|txn|id)\s*[:]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,20})/i;
686	    const matchRef = rawBody.match(refRegex);
687	    if (matchRef && matchRef[1]) {
688	      parsedReferenceId = matchRef[1];
689	    }
690	
691	    const phoneRegex = /(01[0-9]{9}|[0-9]{10,24}|[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)/;
692	    const matchPhone = rawBody.match(phoneRegex);
693	    if (matchPhone && matchPhone[1]) {
694	      parsedAccountNumber = matchPhone[1];
695	    }
696	
697	    return {
698	      sender,
699	      rawBody,
700	      parsedAmount,
701	      parsedReferenceId,
702	      parsedAccountNumber,
703	      parsedProvider,
704	      status: 'unmatched',
705	    };
706	  }
707	
708	  static async addIncomingSms(sender: string, rawBody: string): Promise<SmsMessage> {
709	    const messages = this.getSmsMessages();
710	    const parsed = this.parseSmsText(rawBody, sender);
711	    
712	    const newSms: SmsMessage = {
713	      id: generateUUID(),
714	      sender,
715	      rawBody,
716	      parsedAmount: parsed.parsedAmount || 0,
717	      parsedReferenceId: parsed.parsedReferenceId || `REF-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
718	      parsedAccountNumber: parsed.parsedAccountNumber,
719	      parsedProvider: parsed.parsedProvider,
720	      status: 'unmatched',
721	      receivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
722	    };
723	
724	    messages.unshift(newSms);
725	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, messages);
726	
727	    // Push to Supabase Cloud
728	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
729	      try {
730	        await getSupabase()!.from('sms_messages').insert({
731	          id: newSms.id,
732	          sender: newSms.sender,
733	          raw_body: newSms.rawBody,
734	          parsed_amount: newSms.parsedAmount || null,
735	          parsed_reference_id: newSms.parsedReferenceId || null,
736	          parsed_account_number: newSms.parsedAccountNumber || null,
737	          parsed_provider: newSms.parsedProvider || null,
738	          status: 'unmatched',
739	          received_at: newSms.receivedAt,
740	        });
741	      } catch (e) {
742	        console.error(e);
743	      }
744	    }
745	
746	    return newSms;
747	  }
748	
749	  static async matchSmsToOrder(smsId: string, orderId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
750	    const currentUser = this.getCurrentUser();
751	    const messages = this.getSmsMessages();
752	    const sms = messages.find(m => m.id === smsId);
753	
754	    if (!sms) return { success: false, message: 'رسالة الدفع غير موجودة' };
755	    if (sms.status === 'matched') return { success: false, message: 'هذه الرسالة تم مطابقتها واحتسابها مسبقاً' };
756	
757	    const orders = this.getOrders();
758	    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
759	    if (!order) return { success: false, message: 'طلب العميل غير موجود' };
760	
761	    sms.status = 'matched';
762	    sms.matchedOrderId = orderId;
763	    sms.matchedOrderNumber = order.orderNumber;
764	    sms.matchedByUserId = currentUser.id;
765	    sms.matchedAt = new Date().toISOString();
766	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, messages);
767	
768	    order.paidAmount += sms.parsedAmount || 0;
769	    order.remainingAmount = Math.max(0, order.totalAmount - order.paidAmount);
770	    if (order.paidAmount >= order.totalAmount) {
771	      order.orderStatus = 'confirmed';
772	    }
773	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ORDERS, orders);
774	
775	    const accounts = this.getFinancialAccounts();
776	    const account = accounts.find(a => a.provider === sms.parsedProvider);
777	    if (account) {
778	      account.currentBalance += sms.parsedAmount || 0;
779	      saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCOUNTS, accounts);
780	    }
781	
782	    this.addAuditLog(
783	      currentUser.id, 
784	      currentUser.fullName, 
785	      'MATCH_SMS', 
786	      'sales_orders', 
787	      orderId, 
788	      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, amount: sms.parsedAmount, ref: sms.parsedReferenceId }
789	    );
790	
791	    // تحديث SMS في السحابة
792	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
793	      try {
794	        await getSupabase()!.from('sms_messages').update({
795	          status: 'matched',
796	          matched_order_id: orderId,
797	          matched_order_number: order.orderNumber,
798	          matched_by_user_id: currentUser.id,
799	          matched_at: new Date().toISOString(),
800	        }).eq('id', smsId);
801	
802	        // تحديث الطلب في السحابة
803	        await getSupabase()!.from('sales_orders').update({
804	          paid_amount: order.paidAmount,
805	          remaining_amount: order.remainingAmount,
806	          order_status: order.orderStatus,
807	        }).eq('id', orderId);
808	      } catch (e) {
809	        console.error('Cloud SMS match error:', e);
810	      }
811	    }
812	
813	    return { success: true, message: `تم تأكيد سداد مبلغ ${sms.parsedAmount} بنجاح للطلب #${order.orderNumber}` };
814	  }

Two cloud inserts failed with 400 (permits and sms_messages) — Supabase returns errors without throwing, so I must inspect the schema to find the bad columns.

Found it: `permits.assigned_by_user_id`/`locked_by_user_id` and `sms_messages.matched_by_user_id` are UUID FKs to `profiles(id)` — but demo profile ids like `user-sales-1` aren't UUIDs, so inserts fail. Let me check `sales_orders.created_by` too.

Confirmed — `sales_orders.created_by` is TEXT (that's why orders passed), but the three UUID FK columns on permits/sms must be null. Fixing the seed.

Assigned permits render with return actions. Now checking Orders.

Orders render fully, but I spotted a consistency wart: cloud BIGSERIAL reassigned order numbers to #11-19 while seeded SMS rows reference #1001-1009. I'll fix the seed to read back the real assigned numbers and use them everywhere.

41	function loadFromStorage<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
42	  try {
43	    const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
44	    return item ? JSON.parse(item) : fallback;
45	  } catch (e) {
46	    console.error(`Failed to load ${key} from storage:`, e);
47	    return fallback;
48	  }
49	}
50	
51	function saveToStorage<T>(key: string, data: T): void {
52	  try {
53	    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
54	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('rawdah_storage_update'));
55	  } catch (e) {
56	    console.error(`Failed to save ${key} to storage:`, e);
57	  }
58	}

60	// Generate valid UUID v4 for PostgreSQL
61	function generateUUID(): string {
62	  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
63	    const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
64	    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
65	    return v.toString(16);
66	  });
67	}

441	  static async claimPermit(
442	    permitId: string, 
443	    customerId: string, 
444	    orderId?: string, 
445	    user?: UserProfile
446	  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; permit?: Permit }> {
447	    const currentUser = user || this.getCurrentUser();
448	    const permits = this.getPermits();
449	    const permitIndex = permits.findIndex(p => p.id === permitId);
450	
451	    if (permitIndex === -1) {
452	      return { success: false, message: 'التصريح غير موجود في النظام' };
453	    }
454	
455	    const permit = permits[permitIndex];
456	    if (permit.status !== 'available') {
457	      return { success: false, message: 'عذراً، هذا التصريح تم حجزه بالفعل من موظف آخر لحظياً' };
458	    }
459	
460	    const customer = this.getCustomers().find(c => c.id === customerId);
461	    if (!customer) {
462	      return { success: false, message: 'العميل المحدد غير موجود' };
463	    }
464	
465	    permit.status = 'assigned';
466	    permit.assignedToCustomerId = customerId;
467	    permit.assignedCustomerName = customer.fullName;
468	    permit.assignedByUserId = currentUser.id;
469	    permit.assignedByUserName = currentUser.fullName;
470	    permit.assignedAt = new Date().toISOString();
471	
472	    permits[permitIndex] = permit;
473	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMITS, permits);
474	
475	    // Push claim to Cloud
476	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
477	      try {
478	        const { error } = await getSupabase()!.from('permits').update({
479	          status: 'assigned',
480	          assigned_to_customer_id: customerId,
481	          assigned_customer_name: customer.fullName,
482	          assigned_by_user_id: currentUser.id,
483	          assigned_by_user_name: currentUser.fullName,
484	          assigned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
485	        }).eq('id', permitId);
486	        if (error) console.error('Cloud permit claim error:', error);
487	      } catch (e) {
488	        console.error(e);
489	      }
490	    }
491	
492	    this.addAuditLog(
493	      currentUser.id, 
494	      currentUser.fullName, 
495	      'CLAIM_PERMIT', 
496	      'permits', 
497	      permitId, 
498	      { permitCode: permit.permitCode, customerName: customer.fullName, slot: permit.slotFormatted }
499	    );
500	
501	    return { success: true, message: 'تم تخصيص التصريح للعميل بنجاح', permit };
502	  }

504	  static async returnPermit(
505	    permitId: string, 
506	    reason: string = 'إلغاء من قبل العميل',
507	    user?: UserProfile
508	  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
509	    const currentUser = user || this.getCurrentUser();
510	    const permits = this.getPermits();
511	    const permitIndex = permits.findIndex(p => p.id === permitId);
512	
513	    if (permitIndex === -1) {
514	      return { success: false, message: 'التصريح غير موجود' };
515	    }
516	
517	    const permit = permits[permitIndex];
518	    const prevCustomerName = permit.assignedCustomerName;
519	
520	    if (permit.status !== 'assigned' && permit.status !== 'locked') {
521	      return { success: false, message: 'هذا التصريح غير مخصص لأي عميل حالياً، لا حاجة لإرجاعه' };
522	    }
523	
524	    permit.status = 'available';
525	    permit.assignedToCustomerId = undefined;
526	    permit.assignedCustomerName = undefined;
527	    permit.assignedByUserId = undefined;
528	    permit.assignedByUserName = undefined;
529	    permit.assignedAt = undefined;
530	
531	    permits[permitIndex] = permit;
532	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMITS, permits);
533	
534	    // Push return to Cloud
535	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
536	      try {
537	        await getSupabase()!.from('permits').update({
538	          status: 'available',
539	          assigned_to_customer_id: null,
540	          assigned_customer_name: null,
541	          assigned_by_user_id: null,
542	          assigned_by_user_name: null,
543	          assigned_at: null,
544	        }).eq('id', permitId);
545	      } catch (e) {
546	        console.error(e);
547	      }
548	    }
549	
550	    this.addAuditLog(
551	      currentUser.id, 
552	      currentUser.fullName, 
553	      'RETURN_PERMIT', 
554	      'permits', 
555	      permitId, 
556	      { permitCode: permit.permitCode, reason, previousCustomerName: prevCustomerName, slot: permit.slotFormatted }
557	    );
558	
559	    return { success: true, message: 'تم إرجاع التصريح للمخزون بنجاح' };
560	  }

562	  static async addPermitsBulk(
563	    date: string, 
564	    hour: number, 
565	    minute: 0 | 20 | 40, 
566	    imageUrls: string[], 
567	    notes?: string
568	  ): Promise<Permit[]> {
569	    const currentUser = this.getCurrentUser();
570	    const permits = this.getPermits();
571	    const newPermits: Permit[] = [];
572	    const baseCode = `PERMIT-${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;
573	    // تسلسل محلي بكل فترة (تاريخ + ساعة + دقيقة) وليس بإجمالي المخزون حتى تبقى الأكواد مرتبة ومتوقعة
574	    const existingInSlot = permits.filter(
575	      p => p.slotDate === date && p.slotHour === hour && p.slotMinute === minute
576	    ).length;
577	    let seq = existingInSlot + 1;
578	
579	    imageUrls.forEach((url, i) => {
580	      const permit: Permit = {
581	        id: generateUUID(),
582	        permitCode: `${baseCode}-${seq++}`,
583	        slotDate: date,
584	        slotHour: hour,
585	        slotMinute: minute,
586	        slotFormatted: `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`,
587	        imageUrl: url,
588	        status: 'available',
589	        notes: notes || '',
590	        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
591	      };
592	      newPermits.push(permit);
593	      permits.push(permit);
594	    });
595	
596	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMITS, permits);
597	
598	    // Push bulk to Cloud
599	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
600	      try {
601	        const { error } = await getSupabase()!.from('permits').insert(
602	          newPermits.map(p => ({
603	            id: p.id,
604	            permit_code: p.permitCode,
605	            slot_date: p.slotDate,
606	            slot_hour: p.slotHour,
607	            slot_minute: p.slotMinute,
608	            // slot_formatted هو GENERATED ALWAYS AS في Supabase — لا يُكتب مباشرة
609	            image_url: p.imageUrl,
610	            status: 'available',
611	            notes: p.notes || null,
612	          }))
613	        );
614	        if (error) console.error('Cloud bulk insert error:', error);
615	      } catch (e) {
616	        console.error(e);
617	      }
618	    }
619	
620	    this.addAuditLog(
621	      currentUser.id, 
622	      currentUser.fullName, 
623	      'UPLOAD_PERMITS', 
624	      'permits', 
625	      newPermits[0]?.id || 'bulk', 
626	      { count: newPermits.length, slot: `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`, date }
627	    );
628	
629	    return newPermits;
630	  }

729	  static getSmsMessages(): SmsMessage[] {
730	    return loadFromStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, initialSmsMessages);
731	  }
732	
733	  static parseSmsText(rawBody: string, sender: string): Partial<SmsMessage> {
734	    let parsedAmount: number | undefined;
735	    let parsedReferenceId: string | undefined;
736	    let parsedAccountNumber: string | undefined;
737	    let parsedProvider: AccountProvider = 'other';
738	
739	    const lowerSender = sender.toLowerCase();
740	    const lowerBody = rawBody.toLowerCase();
741	
742	    if (lowerSender.includes('vf') || lowerSender.includes('vodafone') || lowerBody.includes('فودافون كاش')) {
743	      parsedProvider = 'vodafone_cash';
744	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('orange') || lowerBody.includes('أورانج كاش') || lowerBody.includes('اورنج')) {
745	      parsedProvider = 'orange_cash';
746	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('etisalat') || lowerBody.includes('اتصالات كاش')) {
747	      parsedProvider = 'etisalat_cash';
748	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('instapay') || lowerBody.includes('instapay') || lowerBody.includes('انستاباي')) {
749	      parsedProvider = 'instapay';
750	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('rajhi') || lowerBody.includes('الراجحي')) {
751	      parsedProvider = 'al_rajhi';
752	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('ahli') || lowerSender.includes('snb') || lowerBody.includes('الأهلي')) {
753	      parsedProvider = 'al_ahli';
754	    }
755	
756	    const amountRegex = /(?:مبلغ|استلام|تحويل|بمبلغ|قيمة|amount|received)\s*[:]?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)/i;
757	    const matchAmount = rawBody.match(amountRegex);
758	    if (matchAmount && matchAmount[1]) {
759	      parsedAmount = parseFloat(matchAmount[1]);
760	    } else {
761	      const anyNum = rawBody.match(/([0-9]{2,6}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)/);
762	      if (anyNum) parsedAmount = parseFloat(anyNum[1]);
763	    }
764	
765	    const refRegex = /(?:رقم العملية|مرجع|المرجع|العملية|ref|reference|txn|id)\s*[:]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,20})/i;
766	    const matchRef = rawBody.match(refRegex);
767	    if (matchRef && matchRef[1]) {
768	      parsedReferenceId = matchRef[1];
769	    }
770	
771	    const phoneRegex = /(01[0-9]{9}|[0-9]{10,24}|[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)/;
772	    const matchPhone = rawBody.match(phoneRegex);
773	    if (matchPhone && matchPhone[1]) {
774	      parsedAccountNumber = matchPhone[1];
775	    }
776	
777	    return {
778	      sender,
779	      rawBody,
780	      parsedAmount,
781	      parsedReferenceId,
782	      parsedAccountNumber,
783	      parsedProvider,
784	      status: 'unmatched',
785	    };
786	  }
787	
788	  static async addIncomingSms(sender: string, rawBody: string): Promise<SmsMessage> {
789	    const messages = this.getSmsMessages();
790	    const parsed = this.parseSmsText(rawBody, sender);
791	    
792	    const newSms: SmsMessage = {
793	      id: generateUUID(),
794	      sender,
795	      rawBody,
796	      parsedAmount: parsed.parsedAmount || 0,
797	      parsedReferenceId: parsed.parsedReferenceId || `REF-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
798	      parsedAccountNumber: parsed.parsedAccountNumber,
799	      parsedProvider: parsed.parsedProvider,
800	      status: 'unmatched',
801	      receivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
802	    };
803	
804	    messages.unshift(newSms);
805	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, messages);
806	
807	    // Push to Supabase Cloud
808	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
809	      try {
810	        await getSupabase()!.from('sms_messages').insert({
811	          id: newSms.id,
812	          sender: newSms.sender,
813	          raw_body: newSms.rawBody,
814	          parsed_amount: newSms.parsedAmount || null,
815	          parsed_reference_id: newSms.parsedReferenceId || null,
816	          parsed_account_number: newSms.parsedAccountNumber || null,
817	          parsed_provider: newSms.parsedProvider || null,
818	          status: 'unmatched',
819	          received_at: newSms.receivedAt,
820	        });
821	      } catch (e) {
822	        console.error(e);
823	      }
824	    }
825	
826	    return newSms;
827	  }
828	
829	  static async matchSmsToOrder(smsId: string, orderId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
830	    const currentUser = this.getCurrentUser();
831	    const messages = this.getSmsMessages();
832	    const sms = messages.find(m => m.id === smsId);
833	
834	    if (!sms) return { success: false, message: 'رسالة الدفع غير موجودة' };
835	    if (sms.status === 'matched') return { success: false, message: 'هذه الرسالة تم مطابقتها واحتسابها مسبقاً' };
836	
837	    const orders = this.getOrders();
838	    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
839	    if (!order) return { success: false, message: 'طلب العميل غير موجود' };
840	
841	    sms.status = 'matched';
842	    sms.matchedOrderId = orderId;
843	    sms.matchedOrderNumber = order.orderNumber;
844	    sms.matchedByUserId = currentUser.id;
845	    sms.matchedAt = new Date().toISOString();
846	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, messages);
847	
848	    order.paidAmount += sms.parsedAmount || 0;
849	    order.remainingAmount = Math.max(0, order.totalAmount - order.paidAmount);
850	    if (order.paidAmount >= order.totalAmount) {
851	      order.orderStatus = 'confirmed';
852	    }
853	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ORDERS, orders);
854	
855	    const accounts = this.getFinancialAccounts();
856	    const account = accounts.find(a => a.provider === sms.parsedProvider);
857	    if (account) {
858	      account.currentBalance += sms.parsedAmount || 0;
859	      saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCOUNTS, accounts);
860	
861	      // Push updated balance to cloud
862	      if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
863	        getSupabase()!.from('financial_accounts').update({
864	          current_balance: account.currentBalance,
865	        }).eq('id', account.id).then(({ error }) => {
866	          if (error) console.error('Cloud account balance update error:', error);
867	        });
868	      }
869	    }
870	
871	    this.addAuditLog(
872	      currentUser.id, 
873	      currentUser.fullName, 
874	      'MATCH_SMS', 
875	      'sales_orders', 
876	      orderId, 
877	      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, amount: sms.parsedAmount, ref: sms.parsedReferenceId }
878	    );
879	
880	    // تحديث SMS في السحابة

```ts
import { Customer, Permit, SalesOrder, SmsMessage, FinancialAccount, AuditLog } from '../types';

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

export function riyadhToday(offsetDays = 0): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const base = new Date(now.toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh' }));
  base.setDate(base.getDate() + offsetDays);
  return `${base.getFullYear()}-${pad(base.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(base.getDate())}`;
}

function isoHoursAgo(h: number): string { return new Date(Date.now() - h * 3600 * 1000).toISOString(); }
function isoDaysAgo(d: number, hour: number): string {
  const t = new Date(Date.now() - d * 86400 * 1000); t.setHours(hour, Math.floor(Math.random()*59), 0, 0); return t.toISOString();
}

function permitSvg(code: string, time: string): string {
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="400" viewBox="0 0 640 400">...`;
  return `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
}
```

```ts
static async seedLiveDemo(): Promise<{ permits: number; orders: number; customers: number; sms: number; accounts: number; logs: number }> {
  await this.wipeAllData();
  const demo = buildDemoDataset();
  saveToStorage(CUSTOMERS, demo.customers);
  saveToStorage(PERMITS, demo.permits);
  saveToStorage(ORDERS, demo.orders);
  saveToStorage(SMS, demo.smsMessages);
  saveToStorage(ACCOUNTS, demo.financialAccounts);
  saveToStorage(LOGS, demo.auditLogs);

  if cloud: insert all (customers, permits, orders (without order_number), sms, accounts upsert, audit logs)
  return counts;
}
```

#### Thinking

Slot 09:00 tomorrow shows 2 permits, both "مخصص" (assigned) with "إرجاع للمخزون" (return to stock) buttons — these are the ones assigned to order 1003 (family الدوسري, 4 people... actually 2 of them). The status shows "مخصص" — hmm, the status chip says "مخصص" for assigned. Wait, but these should show as assigned-to-customer. The card shows "مخصص" status and a return button. 

Interesting: these were seeded as locked in my design (2 locked by sales for order 1003 at 09:00 tomorrow), but the UI shows them as "مخصص" with إرجاع button. Either way — non-available state renders with correct actions. Actually wait, looking again at snapshot: "مخصص" - this is how the UI labels assigned permits. So the demo data marked these as assigned (linked to order/customer), not locked. Fine — the data is consistent and the return action is available. The important thing is the state machine renders correctly.

Now let's check Orders. Click الطلبات.

Assigned permits render with return actions. Now checking Orders.

#### Thinking

Orders render with real cloud order numbers #11-#19 (BIGSERIAL continued from previous seed — my design #1001-1009 were local-only; cloud assigns its own. That's correct behavior — local orderNumber mapped from cloud on sync. Wait, interesting: the local dataset seeded orderNumber 1001-1009, but after cloud round-trip, syncFromCloud maps cloud order_number (11-19 since BIGSERIAL continued after old data 1-10) and overwrote local. This is correct behavior — the cloud is the source of truth.

Wait, but that means the seed's matched SMS references (matchedOrderNumber 1001-1009) are now inconsistent with displayed order numbers 11-19? Let me check the SMS screen. The sms_messages cloud table has matched_order_number BIGINT values (1001 etc. seeded). On sync, mappedSms uses s.matched_order_number from cloud. So SMS screen will show 1001... while orders show 11-19. Hmm — a cosmetic inconsistency introduced by the BIGSERIAL reassignment on cloud round-trip.

Also matched_order_id FK references still work (real UUIDs).

Is this worth fixing? The seed sets local orderNumber 1001-1009 and cloud assigns 11-19; after any reload, syncFromCloud overwrites local order numbers with cloud ones. The SMS matched_order_number in cloud is 1001-1009 (seeded), which no longer matches any order number shown. That's a data-consistency wart in the demo.

How does the app normally handle this? In production, orders are created via DataService.createOrder which inserts without order_number and then... let me check what createOrder does with the returned order_number — presumably it reads data[0].order_number and stores locally. So in production flow, matched SMS stores the real order number.

For the demo seed, to keep everything consistent after cloud round-trip, I could set local order numbers to the same values cloud will assign — but BIGSERIAL is unpredictable. Alternative: after inserting orders to cloud, read back the assigned order numbers and update both local orders and local SMS matched_order_number accordingly. That's the robust approach.

Let me modify seedLiveDemo: after inserting sales_orders, fetch them back (select id, order_number), build a map, update local orders' orderNumber and SMS matchedOrderNumber, and update the sms_messages cloud insert to use the real numbers (insert SMS after orders, using the map).

Actually simpler: capture the insert response — sb.from('sales_orders').insert(...).select('id, order_number') returns the assigned numbers. Then:

The order numbers in localStorage are now cloud-assigned (20-28) — the orderNumMap fix worked for orders. BUT the SMS matched_order_number still shows 1001-1006! That's the old local values. Why?

Looking at my fix: the SMS insert uses `matched_order_number: s.matchedOrderId ? orderNumMap[s.matchedOrderId] ?? s.matchedOrderNumber : null`.

The issue: the demo data (demoData.ts) constructs SMS messages with `matchedOrderNumber: 1001` etc. and `matchedOrderId` pointing to the demo order IDs. The fix maps via orderNumMap... but wait, the cloud insert uses `orderNumMap[s.matchedOrderId]`. Let me check: does the sms object have `matchedOrderId`? The demo builder sets `matchedOrderId` and `matchedOrderNumber`. The orderNumMap keys are `r.id` from the inserted orders — the demo order IDs (UUIDs). So orderNumMap[s.matchedOrderId] should give the cloud number (20-28).

But localStorage still shows 1001-1006 for SMS. Why? Because the fix only updates `syncedOrders` local save — it never re-saves SMS locally with updated numbers! The cloud SMS insert uses the mapped number, but the local `rawdah_sms_messages` keeps demo.smsMessages as-is (1001-1006).

So there are two representations:
1. Cloud sms_messages.matched_order_number = mapped (20-28) ✓
2. Local sms_messages.matched_order_number = 1001-1006 ✗

On next cloud sync (pull), local would be overwritten with cloud values... actually how does sync work? The DataService does write-through + initial cloud pull? 41	function loadFromStorage<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
42	  try {
43	    const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
44	    return item ? JSON.parse(item) : fallback;
45	  } catch (e) {
46	    console.error(`Failed to load ${key} from storage:`, e);
47	    return fallback;
48	  }
49	}
50	
51	function saveToStorage<T>(key: string, data: T): void {
52	  try {
53	    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
54	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('rawdah_storage_update'));
55	  } catch (e) {
56	    console.error(`Failed to save ${key} to storage:`, e);
57	  }
58	}
59	
60	// Generate valid UUID v4 for PostgreSQL
61	function generateUUID(): string {
62	  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
63	    const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
64	    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
65	    return v.toString(16);
66	  });
67	}

271	  static async updateCompanySettings(settings: Partial<CompanySettings>): Promise<CompanySettings> {
272	    const current = this.getCompanySettings();
273	    const updated = { ...current, ...settings };
274	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS, updated);
275	
276	    // Push to Supabase Cloud directly
277	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
278	      const sb = getSupabase()!;
279	      try {
280	        // نستخدم id محدداً ثابتاً (row واحدة دائماً) — إذا لم يكن موجوداً يُنشأ تلقائياً
281	        const rowId = updated.id || '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
282	
283	        const { data, error } = await sb.from('company_settings').upsert({
284	          id: rowId,
285	          company_name_ar: updated.companyNameAr,
286	          company_name_en: updated.companyNameEn,
287	          address: updated.address,
288	          primary_phone: updated.primaryPhone,
289	          secondary_phone: updated.secondaryPhone || null,
290	          whatsapp_number: updated.whatsappNumber,
291	          email: updated.email,
292	          logo_url: updated.logoUrl || null,
293	          tax_number: updated.taxNumber || null,
294	          commercial_registry: updated.commercialRegistry || null,
295	          invoice_footer_note: updated.invoiceFooterNote,
296	          currency: updated.currency,
297	          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
298	        }, { onConflict: 'id' }).select();
299	
300	        if (error) {
301	          // الحفظ المحلي تم بالفعل — نكتفي بتسجيل خطأ السحابة دون مقاطعة المستخدم
302	          console.error('Cloud update error in Supabase:', error);
303	        } else {
304	          console.log('✅ Company settings saved to Cloud:', data);
305	          // حدِّث الـ id المحلي بالـ id الفعلي من السحابة
306	          if (data && data[0]) {
307	            const finalUpdated = { ...updated, id: data[0].id };
308	            saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS, finalUpdated);
309	            return finalUpdated;
310	          }
311	        }
312	      } catch (err) {
313	        console.error('Supabase write error:', err);
314	      }
315	    }
316	
317	    return updated;
318	  }

397	  static async saveCustomer(customer: Omit<Customer, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'totalOrdersCount' | 'totalSpent'> & { id?: string }): Promise<Customer> {
398	    const customers = this.getCustomers();
399	    const id = customer.id || generateUUID();
400	    const newCustomer: Customer = {
401	      ...customer,
402	      id,
403	      totalOrdersCount: 0,
404	      totalSpent: 0,
405	      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

408	    const idx = customers.findIndex(c => c.id === id);
409	    if (idx >= 0) {

411	    } else {
412	      customers.unshift(newCustomer);
413	    }
414	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMERS, customers);

424	          nickname: newCustomer.nickname || null,
425	          notes: newCustomer.notes || null,

427	        await getSupabase()!.from('customers').upsert(payload, { onConflict: 'id' });

432	
433	    return newCustomer;

441	  static async claimPermit(
442	    permitId: string, 
443	    customerId: string, 
444	    orderId?: string, 
445	    user?: UserProfile
446	  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; permit?: Permit }> {
447	    const currentUser = user || this.getCurrentUser();
448	    const permits = this.getPermits();
449	    const permitIndex = permits.findIndex(p => p.id === permitId);
450	
451	    if (permitIndex === -1) {
452	      return { success: false, message: 'التصريح غير موجود في النظام' };
453	    }
454	
455	    const permit = permits[permitIndex];
456	    if (permit.status !== 'available') {
457	      return { success: false, message: 'عذراً، هذا التصريح تم حجزه بالفعل من موظف آخر لحظياً' };
458	    }
459	
460	    const customer = this.getCustomers().find(c => c.id === customerId);
461	    if (!customer) {
462	      return { success: false, message: 'العميل المحدد غير موجود' };
463	    }
464	
465	    permit.status = 'assigned';
466	    permit.assignedToCustomerId = customerId;
467	    permit.assignedCustomerName = customer.fullName;
468	    permit.assignedByUserId = currentUser.id;
469	    permit.assignedByUserName = currentUser.fullName;
470	    permit.assignedAt = new Date().toISOString();
471	
472	    permits[permitIndex] = permit;
473	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMITS, permits);
474	
475	    // Push claim to Cloud
476	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
477	      try {
478	        const { error } = await getSupabase()!.from('permits').update({
479	          status: 'assigned',
480	          assigned_to_customer_id: customerId,
481	          assigned_customer_name: customer.fullName,
482	          assigned_by_user_id: currentUser.id,
483	          assigned_by_user_name: currentUser.fullName,
484	          assigned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
485	        }).eq('id', permitId);
486	        if (error) console.error('Cloud permit claim error:', error);
487	      } catch (e) {
488	        console.error(e);
489	      }
490	    }
491	
492	    this.addAuditLog(
493	      currentUser.id, 
494	      currentUser.fullName, 
495	      'CLAIM_PERMIT', 
496	      'permits', 
497	      permitId, 
498	      { permitCode: permit.permitCode, customerName: customer.fullName, slot: permit.slotFormatted }
499	    );
500	
501	    return { success: true, message: 'تم تخصيص التصريح للعميل بنجاح', permit };
502	  }
503	
504	  static async returnPermit(
505	    permitId: string, 
506	    reason: string = 'إلغاء من قبل العميل',
507	    user?: UserProfile
508	  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
509	    const currentUser = user || this.getCurrentUser();
510	    const permits = this.getPermits();
511	    const permitIndex = permits.findIndex(p => p.id === permitId);
512	
513	    if (permitIndex === -1) {
514	      return { success: false, message: 'التصريح غير موجود' };
515	    }
516	
517	    const permit = permits[permitIndex];
518	    const prevCustomerName = permit.assignedCustomerName;
519	
520	    if (permit.status !== 'assigned' && permit.status !== 'locked') {
521	      return { success: false, message: 'هذا التصريح غير مخصص لأي عميل حالياً، لا حاجة لإرجاعه' };
522	    }
523	
524	    permit.status = 'available';
525	    permit.assignedToCustomerId = undefined;
526	    permit.assignedCustomerName = undefined;
527	    permit.assignedByUserId = undefined;
528	    permit.assignedByUserName = undefined;
529	    permit.assignedAt = undefined;
530	
531	    permits[permitIndex] = permit;
532	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PERMITS, permits);
533	
534	    // Push return to Cloud
535	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
536	      try {
537	        await getSupabase()!.from('permits').update({
538	          status: 'available',
539	          assigned_to_customer_id: null,
540	          assigned_customer_name: null,
541	          assigned_by_user_id: null,
542	          assigned_by_user_name: null,
543	          assigned_at: null,
544	        }).eq('id', permitId);
545	      } catch (e) {
546	        console.error(e);
547	      }
548	    }
549	
550	    this.addAuditLog(
551	      currentUser.id, 
552	      currentUser.fullName, 
553	      'RETURN_PERMIT', 
554	      'permits', 
555	      permitId, 
556	      { permitCode: permit.permitCode, reason, previousCustomerName: prevCustomerName, slot: permit.slotFormatted }
557	    );
558	
559	    return { success: true, message: 'تم إرجاع التصريح للمخزون بنجاح' };
560	  }

562	  static async addPermitsBulk(
563	    date: string, 
564	    hour: number, 
565	    minute: 0 | 20 | 40, 
566	    imageUrls: string[], 
567	    notes?: string
568	  ): Promise<Permit[]> {
569	    const currentUser = this.getCurrentUser();
570	    const permits = this.getPermits();
571	    const newPermits: Permit[] = [];
572	    const baseCode = `PERMIT-${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;

732	
733	  static parseSmsText(rawBody: string, sender: string): Partial<SmsMessage> {
734	    let parsedAmount: number | undefined;
735	    let parsedReferenceId: string | undefined;
736	    let parsedAccountNumber: string | undefined;
737	    let parsedProvider: AccountProvider = 'other';
738	
739	    const lowerSender = sender.toLowerCase();
740	    const lowerBody = rawBody.toLowerCase();
741	
742	    if (lowerSender.includes('vf') || lowerSender.includes('vodafone') || lowerBody.includes('فودافون كاش')) {
743	      parsedProvider = 'vodafone_cash';
744	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('orange') || lowerBody.includes('أورانج كاش') || lowerBody.includes('اورنج')) {
745	      parsedProvider = 'orange_cash';
746	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('etisalat') || lowerBody.includes('اتصالات كاش')) {
747	      parsedProvider = 'etisalat_cash';
748	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('instapay') || lowerBody.includes('instapay') || lowerBody.includes('انستاباي')) {
749	      parsedProvider = 'instapay';
750	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('rajhi') || lowerBody.includes('الراجحي')) {
751	      parsedProvider = 'al_rajhi';
752	    } else if (lowerSender.includes('ahli') || lowerSender.includes('snb') || lowerBody.includes('الأهلي')) {
753	      parsedProvider = 'al_ahli';
754	    }
755	
756	    const amountRegex = /(?:مبلغ|استلام|تحويل|بمبلغ|قيمة|amount|received)\s*[:]?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)/i;
757	    const matchAmount = rawBody.match(amountRegex);
758	    if (matchAmount && matchAmount[1]) {
759	      parsedAmount = parseFloat(matchAmount[1]);
760	    } else {
761	      const anyNum = rawBody.match(/([0-9]{2,6}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)/);
762	      if (anyNum) parsedAmount = parseFloat(anyNum[1]);
763	    }
764	
765	    const refRegex = /(?:رقم العملية|مرجع|المرجع|العملية|ref|reference|txn|id)\s*[:]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,20})/i;
766	    const matchRef = rawBody.match(refRegex);
767	    if (matchRef && matchRef[1]) {
768	      parsedReferenceId = matchRef[1];
769	    }
770	
771	    const phoneRegex = /(01[0-9]{9}|[0-9]{10,24}|[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)/;
772	    const matchPhone = rawBody.match(phoneRegex);
773	    if (matchPhone && matchPhone[1]) {
774	      parsedAccountNumber = matchPhone[1];
775	    }
776	
777	    return {
778	      sender,
779	      rawBody,
780	      parsedAmount,
781	      parsedReferenceId,
782	      parsedAccountNumber,
783	      parsedProvider,
784	      status: 'unmatched',
785	    };
786	  }
787	
788	  static async addIncomingSms(sender: string, rawBody: string): Promise<SmsMessage> {
789	    const messages = this.getSmsMessages();
790	    const parsed = this.parseSmsText(rawBody, sender);
791	    
792	    const newSms: SmsMessage = {
793	      id: generateUUID(),
794	      sender,
795	      rawBody,
796	      parsedAmount: parsed.parsedAmount || 0,
797	      parsedReferenceId: parsed.parsedReferenceId || `REF-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
798	      parsedAccountNumber: parsed.parsedAccountNumber,
799	      parsedProvider: parsed.parsedProvider,
800	      status: 'unmatched',
801	      receivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
802	    };
803	
804	    messages.unshift(newSms);
805	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, messages);
806	
807	    // Push to Supabase Cloud
808	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
809	      try {
810	        await getSupabase()!.from('sms_messages').insert({
811	          id: newSms.id,
812	          sender: newSms.sender,
813	          raw_body: newSms.rawBody,
814	          parsed_amount: newSms.parsedAmount || null,
815	          parsed_reference_id: newSms.parsedReferenceId || null,
816	          parsed_account_number: newSms.parsedAccountNumber || null,
817	          parsed_provider: newSms.parsedProvider || null,
818	          status: 'unmatched',
819	          received_at: newSms.receivedAt,
820	        });
821	      } catch (e) {
822	        console.error(e);
823	      }
824	    }
825	
826	    return newSms;
827	  }

829	  static async matchSmsToOrder(smsId: string, orderId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
830	    const currentUser = this.getCurrentUser();
831	    const messages = this.getSmsMessages();
832	    const sms = messages.find(m => m.id === smsId);
833	
834	    if (!sms) return { success: false, message: 'رسالة الدفع غير موجودة' };
835	    if (sms.status === 'matched') return { success: false, message: 'هذه الرسالة تم مطابقتها واحتسابها مسبقاً' };
836	
837	    const orders = this.getOrders();
838	    const order = orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
839	    if (!order) return { success: false, message: 'طلب العميل غير موجود' };
840	
841	    sms.status = 'matched';
842	    sms.matchedOrderId = orderId;
843	    sms.matchedOrderNumber = order.orderNumber;
844	    sms.matchedByUserId = currentUser.id;
845	    sms.matchedAt = new Date().toISOString();
846	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.SMS, messages);
847	
848	    order.paidAmount += sms.parsedAmount || 0;
849	    order.remainingAmount = Math.max(0, order.totalAmount - order.paidAmount);
850	    if (order.paidAmount >= order.totalAmount) {
851	      order.orderStatus = 'confirmed';
852	    }
853	    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ORDERS, orders);
854	
855	    const accounts = this.getFinancialAccounts();
856	    const account = accounts.find(a => a.provider === sms.parsedProvider);
857	    if (account) {
858	      account.currentBalance += sms.parsedAmount || 0;
859	      saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCOUNTS, accounts);
860	
861	      // Push updated balance to cloud
862	      if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
863	        getSupabase()!.from('financial_accounts').update({
864	          current_balance: account.currentBalance,
865	        }).eq('id', account.id).then(({ error }) => {
866	          if (error) console.error('Cloud account balance update error:', error);
867	        });
868	      }
869	    }
870	
871	    this.addAuditLog(
872	      currentUser.id, 
873	      currentUser.fullName, 
874	      'MATCH_SMS', 
875	      'sales_orders', 
876	      orderId, 
877	      { orderNumber: order.orderNumber, amount: sms.parsedAmount, ref: sms.parsedReferenceId }
878	    );
879	
880	    // تحديث SMS في السحابة
881	    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
882	      try {
883	        await getSupabase()!.from('sms_messages').update({
884	          status: 'matched',
885	          matched_order_id: orderId,
886	          matched_order_number: order.orderNumber,
887	          matched_by_user_id: currentUser.id,
888	          matched_at: new Date().toISOString(),
889	        }).eq('id', smsId);
890	
891	        // تحديث الطلب في السحابة
892	        await getSupabase()!.from('sales_orders').update({
893	          paid_amount: order.paidAmount,
894	          remaining_amount: order.remainingAmount,
895	          order_status: order.orderStatus,
896	        }).eq('id', orderId);
897	      } catch (e) {
898	        console.error('Cloud SMS match error:', e);
899	      }
900	    }
901	
902	    return { success: true, message: `تم تأكيد سداد مبلغ ${sms.parsedAmount} بنجاح للطلب #${order.orderNumber}` };
903	  }

936	      if (uuidRegex.test(entityId)) {
937	        getSupabase()!.from('audit_logs').insert({

### **You**

اقتراحاتك  للتطوير وتحسين تجربة المستخدم

### **Assistant**

بناءً على عملي المباشر داخل الكود والتجربة الحية، هذه أهم الاقتراحات مرتبة بالأولوية:

## أولاً: جاهزية الإنتاج (أخطر نقاط قبل التشغيل الحقيقي)

1. **Supabase Auth حقيقي + تفعيل RLS** — حالياً تسجيل الدخول محلي بالكامل (كلمات المرور في الكود)، وسياسات قاعدة البيانات مفتوحة لـ `anon`؛ أي شخص يملك رابط المشروع يقرأ ويكتب كل البيانات. هذا الإصلاح الوحيد يحوّل النظام من تجريبي إلى قابل للتشغيل فعلياً.
2. **إخفاء أزرار "توليد تجربة حية" و"مسح جميع البيانات"** خلف متغير بيئة أو قفل صلاحية — وجودها في الإنتاج كارثة بضغطة واحدة.
3. **ربط المستخدمين بـ `profiles` فعلياً** — حالياً كل سجلات السحابة ترسل `user_id: null` لأن المعرّفات المحلية ليست UUID، فسجل التدقيق السحابي يفقد هوية المنفِّذ.

## ثانياً: قيمة تشغيلية عالية

4. **إرسال واتساب بضغطة** من شاشة الطلب/التصريح عبر `wa.me` برسالة جاهزة (الاسم، الفترة، الكود، المتبقي) — أرقام الواتساب موجودة أصلاً، وتكلفته ساعة عمل.
5. **استقبال SMS حقيقي** — حالياً الرسائل تُولَّد للتجربة؛ الربط الفعلي (تطبيق أندرويد يعيد التوجيه أو رقم مستلم) هو أكبر قفزة قيمة للمحاسبة.
6. **منع ازدواج سحب التصريح** بين موظفين: قفل تلقائي عند فتح الشاشة أو معاملة ذرية سحابية — المشكلة ستظهر حتماً مع فريق مبيعات متزامن.
7. **سجل مالي (Ledger)** لكل حساب بدل رصيد واحد يُعدَّل يدوياً — كل مطابقة SMS تُسجَّل كحركة، فيصير التدقيق المالي دقيقاً وقابلاً للترحيل.

## ثالثاً: تحسينات تجربة مستخدم سريعة

8. **QR code للتصريح + فاتورة PDF قابلة للطباعة** للعميل.
9. **تنبيهات فورية (Toast)** عند وصول SMS جديدة أو طلب جديد، بدل الاعتماد على الشارة.
10. **تصدير CSV** من سجل التدقيق والطلبات، مع بقاء الفلاتر بعد التنقل بين الشاشات.

```tsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Info, X, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';

type ToastType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

interface ToastItem {
  id: number;
  type: ToastType;
  message: string;
  leaving?: boolean;
}

interface ConfirmRequest {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  danger: boolean;
  resolve: (ok: boolean) => void;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  success: (message: string) => void;
  error: (message: string) => void;
  warning: (message: string) => void;
  info: (message: string) => void;
  confirm: (message: string, options?: { title?: string; confirmLabel?: string; danger?: boolean }) => Promise<boolean>;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | null>(null);

export const useToast = (): ToastContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useToast must be used within ToastProvider');
  return ctx;
};
```

```tsx
export const ToastProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
  const [confirmRequest, setConfirmRequest] = useState<ConfirmRequest | null>(null);
  const idRef = useRef(0);
  const timersRef = useRef<Map<number, number>>(new Map());

  const remove = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setToasts(prev => prev.map(t => (t.id === id ? { ...t, leaving: true } : t)));
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
    }, 220);
  }, []);

  const push = useCallback((type: ToastType, message: string) => {

      remove(id);
```

Now I'll implement the atomic guard in claimPermit. The plan:

1. Keep local pre-check (already there).
2. Do the cloud conditional update FIRST with `.eq('id', permitId).eq('status', 'available')` and `.select('id')` to get affected rows. If cloud is configured:

4. After successful cloud claim (or when cloud not configured), apply local change.

However careful: previously local was updated first then pushed to cloud. If I flip the order, in the local-first architecture, claiming requires cloud successful. But if cloud is not configured (env missing), local path still works. That's fine.

Also `.select('id')` on update — Supabase returns the affected rows; with RLS open to anon, update returns rows in `data`. If another row already has status != 'available', the condition fails → data = [] (no error). 

But one subtlety: what if the permit in the cloud has a different status because the local storage is stale (e.g., cloud says assigned but locally available)? Then guard returns "already claimed" — correct behavior, plus we should refresh local data from cloud so UI reflects it. The error message covers it.

```ts
  static async claimPermit(
    permitId: string, 
    customerId: string, 
    orderId?: string, 
    user?: UserProfile
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; permit?: Permit }> {
    const currentUser = user || this.getCurrentUser();
    const permits = this.getPermits();
    const permitIndex = permits.findIndex(p => p.id === permitId);

    if (permitIndex === -1) {
      return { success: false, message: 'التصريح غير موجود في النظام' };
    }

    const permit = permits[permitIndex];
    if (permit.status !== 'available') {
      return { success: false, message: 'عذراً، هذا التصريح تم حجزه بالفعل من موظف آخر لحظياً' };
    }

    const customer = this.getCustomers().find(c => c.id === customerId);
    if (!customer) {
      return { success: false, message: 'العميل المحدد غير موجود' };
    }

    const claimedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    // قيد ذري: التحديث السحابي المشروط أولاً — يمنع سحب نفس التصريح من موظفين متزامنين
    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
      try {
        const { data: updatedRows, error: updateError } = await getSupabase()!
          .from('permits')
          .update({
            status: 'assigned',
            assigned_to_customer_id: customerId,
            assigned_customer_name: customer.fullName,
            // assigned_by_user_id مرجع UUID إلى profiles(auth) — معرّف المستخدم المحلي ليس UUID صالحاً
            assigned_by_user_id: null,
            assigned_by_user_name: currentUser.fullName,
            assigned_at: claimedAt,
          })
          .eq('id', permitId)
          .eq('status', 'available')
          .select('id');

        if (updateError) {
          console.error('Cloud permit claim error:', updateError);
          return { success: false, message: 'تعذر تثبيت الحجز في السحابة، تحقق من الاتصال وحاول مجدداً' };
        }

        if (!updatedRows || updatedRows.length === 0) {
          // لم يتأثر أي صف: إما محجوز للتو من موظف آخر أو غير موجود سحابياً (تصريح محلي فقط)
          const { data: cloudPermit } = await getSupabase()!
            .from('permits')
            .select('id')
            .eq('id', permitId)
            .maybeSingle();

          if (cloudPermit) {
            await this.syncFromCloud();
            window.dispatchEvent(new Event('rawdah_storage_update'));
            return { success: false, message: 'عذراً، هذا التصريح تم حجزه للتو من موظف آخر — تم تحديث الحالة' };
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        return { success: false, message: 'تعذر تثبيت الحجز في السحابة، تحقق من الاتصال وحاول مجدداً' };
      }
    }
```

'مسدد بالكامل' : `متبقي ${order.remainingAmount} ر.س`}\n\nتقبل الله زيارتكم وطاعتكم.`;

```tsx
  const handleOpenWhatsApp = (order: SalesOrder) => {
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${order.customerWhatsapp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent(buildWhatsAppMessage(order))}`, '_blank', 'noopener');
    if (markAsSent && order.deliveryStatus !== 'sent') {
      DataService.updateDeliveryStatus(order.id, 'sent');
      refreshData();
      toast.success('تم تحديث موقف الإرسال إلى «تم إرساله للعميل».');
    }
    setWhatsAppModalOrder(null);
  };

  const handleCopyWhatsAppText = async (order: SalesOrder) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(buildWhatsAppMessage(order));
      toast.success('تم نسخ نص الرسالة إلى الحافظة.');
    } catch {
      toast.error('تعذر النسخ تلقائياً، انسخ النص يدوياً.');
    }
  };
```

Note: the original preview had a subtle inconsistency: `paidAmount >= totalAmount` without the `totalAmount > 0` guard — I'll use the guard to avoid "مسدد" for a 0 total. Actually if totalAmount is 0 (unit price 0), "مسدد بالكامل" is wrong-ish. The table's isFullyPaid uses `paidAmount >= order.totalAmount && order.totalAmount > 0`. Use that.

Also there's an important detail: since it's an `<a>` tag opening in new tab; replacing it with a button + window.open allows the state updates. Keep `<a href>` for reliability? A window.open from a click handler is fine.

Also add "معاينة الرسالة" — the preview is displayed. The preview text should use the same helper: `{buildWhatsAppMessage(whatsAppModalOrder)}` inside the div. But the helper returns an escaped string; in JSX we can render it directly in a template literal context: `<div ...>{buildWhatsAppMessage(whatsAppModalOrder)}</div>`. Good with whitespace-pre-wrap.

```ts
import QRCode from 'qrcode';
import { CompanySettings, Permit, SalesOrder } from '../types';

const escapeHtml = (value: string): string =>
  value.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

const openPrintWindow = (title: string, bodyHtml: string): boolean => {
  const win = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=860,height=940');
  if (!win) return false;
  win.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html>...`);
  win.document.close();
  return true;
};
```

Security: escape all interpolated values (customer names from user input) — XSS in the print window. Use escapeHtml everywhere. For QR data URL we generate it, safe.

Create `src/utils/csvHelpers.ts`:
```ts
export const downloadCsv = (filename: string, headers: string[], rows: (string | number)[][]) => {
  const escapeCell = (value: string | number): string => {
    const text = String(value ?? '');
    return /[",\n\r]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : text;
  };
  // BOM لدعم العربية في Excel
  const content = '\uFEFF' + [headers, ...rows].map(r => r.map(escapeCell).join(',')).join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
};
```

Let me write csvHelpers.ts first.

```ts
export function downloadCsv(filename: string, headers: string[], rows: (string | number)[][]): void {
  const escapeCell = (value: string | number): string => {
    const text = String(value ?? '');
    if (/[",\n\r]/.test(text)) {
      return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    }
    return text;
  };

  const lines = [headers, ...rows].map(row => row.map(escapeCell).join(','));
  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + lines.join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
```

```ts
export function formatDateTimeRiyadh(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  const date = d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh' });
  const time = d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  return `${date} ${time}`;
}
```

```ts
export function openPrintWindow(title: string, bodyHtml: string): boolean {
  const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=860,height=940');
  if (!printWindow) return false;

  printWindow.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<title>${esc(title)}</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body { font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; padding: 24px; }
  .sheet { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); }
  ...
  @media print {
    body { background: #fff; padding: 0; }
    .sheet { box-shadow: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px; max-width: 100%; }
    .no-print { display: none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  ${bodyHtml}
  <div class="no-print" style="max-width:720px;margin:20px auto 0;display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;">
```

Wait — a subtlety: calling `document.write` and then `window.print()` on load. Font loading may cause the print dialog to open before the font renders. Using a small timeout of ~350ms helps. Some implementations wait for `document.fonts.ready`. Let me do:

```html
<script>
  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var go = function () { setTimeout(function () { window.print(); }, 150); };
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) { document.fonts.ready.then(go); } else { go(); }
  });
</script>
```

```json
  "content": "export function formatDateTimeRiyadh(iso: string): string {\n  const date = new Date(iso);\n  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;\n  const day = date.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh' });\n  const time = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {\n    timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh',\n    hour: '2-digit',\n    minute: '2-digit',\n  });\n  return `${day} ${time}`;\n}\n\nexport function todayRiyadh(): string {\n  return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh' });\n}\n\nfunction escapeCsvCell(value: string | number | undefined | null): string {\n  const text = String(value ?? '');\n  if (/[\",\\n\\r]/.test(text)) {\n    return `\"${text.replace(/\"/g, '\"\"')}\"`;\n  }\n  return text;\n}\n\nexport function downloadCsv(\n  filename: string,\n  headers: string[],\n  rows: (string | number | undefined | null)[][]\n): void {\n  const lines = [headers, ...rows].map(row => row.map(escapeCsvCell).join(','));\n  // BOM في البداية حتى تفتح إكسل الملف بالعربية بشكل صحيح\n  const csvContent = '\\uFEFF' + lines.join('\\r\\n');\n\n  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });\n  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n  const link = document.createElement('a');\n  link.href = url;\n  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;\n  document.body.appendChild(link);\n  link.click();\n  document.body.removeChild(link);\n  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n}\n"
}
```

Wait — I placed `handleExportCsv` referencing `filteredOrders` which is defined *after* `handleCopyWhatsAppText` in the file (filteredOrders is defined at line ~145 after handleCopyWhatsAppText). Since these are function declarations inside the component that reference `const filteredOrders` — arrow function bodies only evaluate when called, and by then filteredOrders is initialized. Actually `const handleExportCsv = () => {...}` — the body references `filteredOrders` which is declared later with `const`. That's fine at runtime (TDZ only matters if called before initialization; handlers are called on click, after render). TypeScript may complain "Block-scoped variable 'filteredOrders' used before its declaration"? TS allows referencing a `const` declared later inside a function body (no error — TS only errors when used before declaration in the same immediate execution scope; inside function bodies it's allowed). Yes, this is fine.

label: 'معلومة',\n    container: 'border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/95',\n    iconWrap: 'bg-sky-100 border-sky-200',\n    icon: <Info className=\"w-4 h-4 text-sky-600\" />,\n  },\n};\n\nconst DURATIONS: Record<ToastType, number> = {\n  success: 4000,\n  info: 4000,\n  warning: 5500,\n  error: 7500,\n};\n\nexport const ToastProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {\n  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);\n  const [confirmRequest, setConfirmRequest] = useState<ConfirmRequest | null>(null);\n  const idRef = useRef(0);\n  const timersRef = removeToast(id);\n      }, DURATIONS[type]);\n      timersRef.current.set(id, timer);\n    },\n    [removeToast]\n  );\n\n  const dismiss = useCallback(\n    (id: number) => {\n      const timer = timersRef.current.get(id);\n      if (timer) {\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timersRef.current.delete(id);\n      }\n      removeToast(id);\n    },\n    [removeToast]\n  );\n\n  const confirm = useCallback(\n    (message: string, options?: ConfirmOptions) =>\n      new Promise<boolean>(resolve => {\n        setConfirmRequest({\n          message,\n          title: options?.title ?? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-amber-600'\n                  }`}\n                />\n              </div>\n\n              <div className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\">\n                <h3 className=\"text-base font-bold text-slate-900\">{confirmRequest.title}</h3>\n                <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1.5 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line\">\n                  {confirmRequest.message}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100\">\n              <button\n                onClick={() => {\n                  confirmRequest.resolve(false);\n                  setConfirmRequest(null);\n                }}\n                className=\"px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 transition-colors\"\n              >\n                إلغاء\n              </button>\n              <button\n                onClick={() => {\n                  confirmRequest.resolve(true);\n                  setConfirmRequest(null);\n                }}\n                className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all ${\n                  confirmRequest.danger\n                    ?   "content": "export function formatDateTimeRiyadh(iso: string): string {\n  const date = new Date(iso);\n  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;\n  const day = date.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh' });\n  const time = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {\n    timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh',\n    hour: '2-digit',\n    minute: '2-digit',\n  });\n  return `${day} ${time}`;\n}\n\nexport function todayRiyadh(): string {\n  return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh' });\n}\n\nfunction escapeCsvCell(value: string | number | undefined | null): string {\n  const text = String(value ?? '');\n  if (/[\",\\n\\r]/.test(text)) {\n    return `\"${text.replace(/\"/g, '\"\"')}\"`;\n  }\n  return text;\n}\n\nexport function downloadCsv(\n  filename: string,\n  headers: string[],\n  rows: (string | number | undefined | null)[][]\n): void {\n  const lines = [headers, ...rows].map(row => row.map(escapeCsvCell).join(','));\n  // BOM في البداية حتى تفتح إكسل الملف بالعربية بشكل صحيح\n  const csvContent = '\\uFEFF' + lines.join('\\r\\n');\n\n  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });\n  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n  const link = document.createElement('a');\n  link.href = url;\n  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;\n  document.body.appendChild(link);\n  link.click();\n  document.body.removeChild(link);\n  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n}\n"
```json
}
```

88	export const ToastProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
89	  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
90	  const [confirmRequest, setConfirmRequest] = useState<ConfirmRequest | null>(null);
91	  const idRef = useRef(0);
92	  const timersRef = useRef<Map<number, number>>(new Map());
93	
94	  const removeToast = useCallback((id: number) => {
95	    setToasts(prev => prev.map(t => (t.id === id ? { ...t, leaving: true } : t)));
96	    window.setTimeout(() => {
97	      setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
98	    }, 200);
99	  }, []);
100	
101	  const push = useCallback(
102	    (type: ToastType, message: string) => {
103	      const id = ++idRef.current;

171	      confirm,

173	    [push, confirm]
174	  );
175	
176	  return (
177	    <ToastContext.Provider value={api}>
178	      {children}
179	
180	      {/* Toasts Stack */}
181	      <div className="fixed top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[120] flex flex-col gap-2 w-[min(92vw,430px)] pointer-events-none">
182	        {toasts.map(t => {

189	                t.leaving ? 'toast-leave' : 'toast-enter'

196	                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed break-words">
197	                  {t.message}

- **تحقق فعلي:** أُضيفت "سارة المطيري" وبقيت بعد إعادة التحميل (5 موظفين)، والتعديل حافظ على كلمة المرور عند ترك الحقل فارغاً.

## 2. الحسابات البنكية والمحافظ — حقول ناقصة وبدون إمكانية تعديل
- **أُضيف:** زر تعديل لكل حساب، حقل "فرع البنك" (للبنوك فقط)، "ملاحظات"، مربع "الحساب فعال ومتاح لاستقبال التحويلات"، وشارة فعال/موقوف والفرع على البطاقة.
- **تحقق فعلي:** حفظ ملاحظات فودافون كاش + فرع "فرع العليا - الرياض" للبنك الأهلي، وثبتا بعد إعادة التحميل.

## 3. إعدادات المؤسسة — لا حقل عملة
- **أُضيف:** قائمة عملة (SAR/EGP/USD/AED) وربطها برمز العملة في سندات الطباعة عبر `printHelpers`.
- **تحقق فعلي:** حُوّلت العملة إلى EGP وظهر "ج.م" في سند الطباعة الفعلي، ثم أُرجعت SAR.

## 4. نموذج إنشاء الطلب — كان يسجّل "مسدد بالكامل" دائماً بلا دفعة مقدمة
- **أُضيف:** حقل "دفعة مقدمة (اختياري)" مع شبكة مالية من 3 أعمدة، وحساب المدفوع/المتبقي، واعتماد تلقائي "مؤكد" عند سداد كامل المبلغ.

62	function generateUUID(): string {
63	  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
64	    const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
65	    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
66	    return v.toString(16);
67	  });

a) Add `saveProfile`:
```ts
static async saveProfile(data: Omit<UserProfile, 'id' | 'createdAt'> & { id?: string }): Promise<UserProfile> {
  const profiles = this.getProfiles();
  const id = data.id || generateUUID();
  const existing = profiles.find(p => p.id === id);
  const newProfile: UserProfile = {
    ...data,
    id,
    createdAt: existing?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  // keep password if not provided (edit without changing password)
  if (existing && !data.password) newProfile.password = existing.password;

  const idx = profiles.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
  if (idx >= 0) profiles[idx] = newProfile; else profiles.push(newProfile);
  saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PROFILES, profiles);

  // Push to cloud (كلمات المرور لا تُرسل أبداً)
  if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {
    try {
      await getSupabase()!.from('profiles').upsert({
        id, full_name, username, phone_number, whatsapp_number, role, is_active, avatar_url, custom_permissions
      }, { onConflict: 'id' });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  }
  return newProfile;
}
```

```json
  "new_string": "  static async saveProfile(data: Omit<UserProfile, 'id' | 'createdAt'> & { id?: string }): Promise<UserProfile> {\n    const profiles = this.getProfiles();\n    const id = data.id || generateUUID();\n    const existing = profiles.find(p => p.id === id);\n\n    const newProfile: UserProfile = {\n      ...data,\n      id,\n      // عند التعديل بدون إدخال كلمة مرور جديدة نُبقي القديمة\n      password: data.password || existing?.password || '',\n      createdAt: existing?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    const idx = profiles.findIndex(p => p.id === id);\n    if (idx >= 0) {\n      profiles[idx] = newProfile;\n    } else {\n      profiles.push(newProfile);\n    }\n    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PROFILES, profiles);\n\n    // Push to cloud — كلمات المرور لا تُرسل أبداً\n    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {\n      try {\n        await getSupabase()!.from('profiles').upsert({\n          id: newProfile.id,\n          full_name: newProfile.fullName,\n          username: newProfile.username,\n          phone_number: newProfile.phoneNumber || null,\n          whatsapp_number: newProfile.whatsappNumber || null,\n          role: newProfile.role,\n          is_active: newProfile.isActive,\n          avatar_url: newProfile.avatarUrl || null,\n          custom_permissions: newProfile.customPermissions,\n        }, { onConflict: 'id' });\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error(e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return newProfile;\n  }\n\n  static isUsernameTaken(username: string, excludeId?: string): boolean {\n    const target = username.trim().toLowerCase();\n    return this.getProfiles().some(p => p.id !== excludeId && p.username.toLowerCase() === target);\n  }",
  "old_string": "  static updateProfile(id: string, updates: Partial<UserProfile>): void {\n    const profiles = this.getProfiles();\n    const idx = profiles.findIndex(p => p.id === id);\n    if (idx >= 0) {\n      profiles[idx] = { ...profiles[idx], ...updates };\n      saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PROFILES, profiles);\n    }\n  }"
}
```

Safest: evaluate_script with native setter + input/change events dispatched, which React picks up. For a native select: 
```js
const sel = document.querySelectorAll('select')[0]; // customer select
const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set;
setter.call(sel, '<customerId>');
sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
```
React's onChange for select listens to 'change' event (React uses 'change' for select). Actually React attaches 'change' → onChange for select elements works with dispatched 'change' event. But React's value tracking: for select, React tracks value similarly; using the native setter bypasses the tracker so the event isn't swallowed. This is the standard trick.

Actually careful: React controlled number inputs — setting via native setter + 'input' event. React's onChange for inputs listens to 'input' events (React 18: onChange → input event for text/number inputs). With native setter trick, event not swallowed, state updates.

Plan the script:
```js
() => {
  const customers = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rawdah_customers') || '[]');
  const c = customers.find(x => x.fullName && x.fullName.includes('فاطمة'));
  const form = document.querySelector('form');
  const selects = form.querySelectorAll('select');
  const customerSelect = selects[0];
  const setSelect = (el, val) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, val); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); };
  setSelect(customerSelect, c.id);
  const numbers = form.querySelectorAll('input[type="number"]');
  const setNum = (el, val) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, String(val)); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); };
  setNum(numbers[0], 2); // permits count
  setNum(numbers[2], 100); // paid amount (0=permits,1=unitPrice,2=paid)
  return JSON.stringify({customerId: c.id, name: c.fullName, numbers: numbers.length});
}
```

## 1. فريق العمل والصلاحيات — لم تكن هناك واجهة إضافة/تعديل موظف نهائياً

42	function loadFromStorage<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
43	  try {
44	    const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
45	    return item ? JSON.parse(item) : fallback;
46	  } catch (e) {
47	    console.error(`Failed to load ${key} from storage:`, e);
48	    return fallback;
49	  }
50	}
51	
52	function saveToStorage<T>(key: string, data: T): void {
53	  try {
54	    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
55	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('rawdah_storage_update'));
56	  } catch (e) {
57	    console.error(`Failed to save ${key} to storage:`, e);
58	  }
59	}

61	// Generate valid UUID v4 for PostgreSQL
62	function generateUUID(): string {
63	  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
64	    const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
65	    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
66	    return v.toString(16);
67	  });
68	}

601	  static async addPermitsBulk(
602	    date: string, 
603	    hour: number, 
604	    minute: 0 | 20 | 40, 
605	    imageUrls: string[], 
606	    notes?: string
607	  ): Promise<Permit[]> {
608	    const currentUser = this.getCurrentUser();
609	    const permits = this.getPermits();
610	    const newPermits: Permit[] = [];
611	    const baseCode = `PERMIT-${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;
612	    // تسلسل محلي بكل فترة (تاريخ + ساعة + دقيقة) وليس بإجمالي المخزون حتى تبقى الأكواد مرتبة ومتوقعة
613	    const existingInSlot = permits.filter(
614	      p => p.slotDate === date && p.slotHour === hour && p.slotMinute === minute
615	    ).length;
616	    let seq = existingInSlot + 1;
617	
618	    imageUrls.forEach((url, i) => {
619	      const permit: Permit = {
620	        id: generateUUID(),
621	        permitCode: `${baseCode}-${seq++}`,

626	        imageUrl: url,
627	        status: 'available',

62	function generateUUID(): string {
63	  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
64	    const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
65	    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
66	    return v.toString(16);
67	  });
68	}

```json
  "new_string": "  static async saveProfile(data: Omit<UserProfile, 'id' | 'createdAt'> & { id?: string }): Promise<UserProfile> {\n    const profiles = this.getProfiles();\n    const id = data.id || generateUUID();\n    const existing = profiles.find(p => p.id === id);\n\n    const newProfile: UserProfile = {\n      ...data,\n      id,\n      // عند التعديل بدون إدخال كلمة مرور جديدة نُبقي القديمة\n      password: data.password || existing?.password || '',\n      createdAt: existing?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    const idx = profiles.findIndex(p => p.id === id);\n    if (idx >= 0) {\n      profiles[idx] = newProfile;\n    } else {\n      profiles.push(newProfile);\n    }\n    saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PROFILES, profiles);\n\n    // Push to cloud — كلمات المرور لا تُرسل أبداً\n    if (getIsConfigured() && getSupabase()) {\n      try {\n        await getSupabase()!.from('profiles').upsert({\n          id: newProfile.id,\n          full_name: newProfile.fullName,\n          username: newProfile.username,\n          phone_number: newProfile.phoneNumber || null,\n          whatsapp_number: newProfile.whatsappNumber || null,\n          role: newProfile.role,\n          is_active: newProfile.isActive,\n          avatar_url: newProfile.avatarUrl || null,\n          custom_permissions: newProfile.customPermissions,\n        }, { onConflict: 'id' });\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error(e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return newProfile;\n  }\n\n  static isUsernameTaken(username: string, excludeId?: string): boolean {\n    const target = username.trim().toLowerCase();\n    return this.getProfiles().some(p => p.id !== excludeId && p.username.toLowerCase() === target);\n  }",
  "old_string": "  static updateProfile(id: string, updates: Partial<UserProfile>): void {\n    const profiles = this.getProfiles();\n    const idx = profiles.findIndex(p => p.id === id);\n    if (idx >= 0) {\n      profiles[idx] = { ...profiles[idx], ...updates };\n      saveToStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.PROFILES, profiles);\n    }\n  }"
}
```

```json
    "function": "() => { const customers = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rawdah_customers') || '[]'); const c = customers.find(x => (x.fullName || '').includes('فاطمة')); const form = document.querySelector('form'); if (!form || !c) return JSON.stringify({error: 'missing form or customer'}); const setSelect = (el, val) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, val); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const setNum = (el, val) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, String(val)); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; const selects = form.querySelectorAll('select'); setSelect(selects[0], c.id); const numbers = form.querySelectorAll('input[type=\"number\"]'); setNum(numbers[0], 2); setNum(numbers[2], 100); return JSON.stringify({customerId: c.id, name: c.fullName, numbersCount: numbers.length}); }"
  }
}
```

## 1. مكوّن موحّد لرفع الصور — `ImageUploadField.tsx`
كان موجوداً ومستخدماً في صورتين فقط، فأعدت توحيد منطقه واستخراج الضغط في `src/utils/imageHelpers.ts` ليُستخدم في كل مكان:
- **رفع صورة من الجهاز** (اختيار ملف) + **سحب وإفلات** + **رابط خارجي** كبديل + معاينة فورية + زر "إزالة الصورة".
- تحقق من النوع (JPG/PNG/WebP) والحد الأقصى 10 ميجابايت قبل القراءة.
- ضغط تلقائي مع الحفاظ على شفافية الشعارات: PNG يُقارن مع JPEG بخلفية بيضاء، ويُختار الأصغر (JPEG فقط لو وفّر ≥30%).

**الأماكن الموصّلة:**
| المكان | الحد الأقصى للضغط | النتيجة الفعلية من ملف تجريبي 1.35MB |
|---|---|---|
| صورة الموظف (`EmployeesAndRolesView`) | 256px | **15KB** |
| شعار المؤسسة (`CompanySettingsView`) | 512px | **40KB** |
| صور التصاريح (`PermitsInventory`) | 1200px | **124KB** |

## 2. إصلاح مخزون التصاريح (كان الثغرة الأكبر)
التصاريح كانت ترفع بدون ضغط وبدون حد للحجم — خطر حقيقي على مساحة المتصفح. الآن الصور تُضغط أولاً (1200px)، مع رسالة "جاري تجهيز الصور وضغطها..."، وتخطّي تلقائي لأي ملف غير صالح مع تنبيه واضح.

## 3. حماية من فقدان البيانات الصامت
المشكلة الأخطر التي اكتشفتها: عند امتلاء مساحة المتصفح كان `saveToStorage` يبتلع الخطأ **ويظهر للمستخدم رسالة نجاح كاذبة**. الإصلاح:
- `saveToStorage` يرجع `boolean`، ويُطلق حدث `rawdah_storage_error` عند الامتلاء.
- `ToastProvider` يلتقط الحدث ويعرض تنبيهاً أحمر واضحاً بالعربية.
- `saveProfile` و`updateCompanySettings` يرجّعان `localSaved`، والشاشات الثلاث لم تعد تعرض "نجاح" إلا لو الحفظ تم فعلاً (ونموذج الموظف يبقى مفتوحاً بدل ما يُغلق ويضيّع البيانات).

## 4. التحقق
جرّبته حياً في المتصفح: رفعت الملف من الجهاز في الأماكن الثلاثة، وتأكدت من الضغط والأحجام الفعلية في `localStorage`، وجرّبت محاكاة امتلاء المساحة فظهر تنبيه الخطأ فقط. البناء النهائي (`tsc && vite build`) ناجح في 14.80 ثانية.

**ملاحظة تنظيف:** أزلت شعار الاختبار من الإعدادات (قبل الاختبار كان فارغاً) حتى لا يظهر في طباعة الفواتير. أما تصريح الاختبار `PERMIT-0000-4` وصورة الموظفة التجريبية فتركتهما كبيانات تجربة حية متناسقة مع باقي النظام.
